verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair axis for a GPU, and NVIDIA documents them well. The CUDA Toolkit provides GPU-accelerated libraries, a C/C++ compiler, a runtime, and Nsight debugging and profiling tools, with C++ and Python (cuTile) programming models. The RTX 5080 page also points to curated, GPU-optimized SDKs across Windows ML, Ollama and PyTorch. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with these SDKs on the RTX 5080, and an explicit statement in the CUDA docs that the RTX 5080 (Blackwell consumer) is supported.
